description: Helpdesk tickets and phone support for about 50 agency users; status notices; security incident notices to agencies and the prime
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The company's notice clocks start before any system is back: suspected CJI incidents reported within 1 hour (CJISSECPOL v6.1 IR-6; AC-01 contract); FTI incidents to the prime and the revenue agency at once so the agency can meet its 24-hour TIGTA and IRS report (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8.4); counties and cities need facts in time for their 12-hour ransomware reports (Fla. Stat. 282.3185(5)(b))
manual_workaround: Printed agency contact card and incident binder; company mobile phones; agency security contacts called directly; status updates by phone
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; helpdesk vendor; mobile phone carrier; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Operations Manager; Implementation and Support Analyst; owner as backup

description: Pretrial officers record conditions of release, check-ins, court dates, and violations for about 4,800 supervision cases
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: AC-01 contract: recovery time 24 hours, recovery point 4 hours, 99.5% monthly availability with service credits. Officers can run about 2 days from printed caseload rosters and the sheriff's own jail system; after that court reports and violation follow-up stop, and an officer could miss a supervisee's new arrest or missed check-in
manual_workaround: Printed caseload roster (refreshed weekly by the sheriff); paper check-in log; sheriff's jail management system for custody status
dependent_third_parties: Platform vendor; IaaS provider; sheriff's identity provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Lead Platform Engineer; owner; AC-01 pretrial supervisor

description: Nightly file of new bookings and criminal history summaries pulled from the sheriff's file drop, transformed on SYS-02, and loaded into the AC-01 workspace
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The sheriff's drop keeps 7 days of files, so a missed night can be replayed. After 3 days officers must key new defendants by hand, which delays first contact with new supervisees
manual_workaround: Pretrial staff key new cases from the jail system; sheriff resends missed files
dependent_third_parties: IaaS provider; platform vendor; sheriff IT (file drop)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Lead Platform Engineer; Integration Consultant as backup

description: Caseworkers take applications for one-time rent and utility payments, check documents, decide, and issue payment requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: AC-02 contract: recovery time 24 hours, recovery point 4 hours. County program rule: a complete application gets a decision within 5 business days. Applicants face eviction or utility shutoff, so more than 2 days of downtime pushes cases toward the deadline
manual_workaround: Paper application and checklist; decisions on paper with later entry; urgent shutoff cases handled by phone with the utility
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (account lead); Platform Developers; AC-02 program manager

business_process: Municipal code enforcement and constituent requests (AC-03, AC-04)
description: City staff log complaints, inspections, notices of violation, and constituent requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: City contracts: recovery time 72 hours, recovery point 24 hours. Inspections continue on paper for several days
manual_workaround: Paper complaint forms and inspection sheets; entry after recovery
dependent_people_or_facilities: Implementation and Support Analyst; Platform Developers

description: The Integration Consultant validates converted tax records inside the revenue agency's virtual desktop
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Subcontract milestones are weekly; a lost week costs about $3,200 of billings. Only 2 company laptops are approved by the agency CISO to connect, so a lost laptop stops the work until an approved replacement exists. No FTI is stored by the company, so the recovery point applies only to the consultant's non-FTI work notes
manual_workaround: Lead Platform Engineer (named backup) continues on an approved laptop; agency-site workstation by arrangement with the prime
dependent_third_parties: Revenue agency (virtual desktop and MFA); prime integrator; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Integration Consultant; Lead Platform Engineer as backup

description: Platform Developers build changes in the sandbox and promote them; interface scripts are changed in the repository and deployed to SYS-02
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed to fix defects and to rebuild SYS-02 after an incident. Exported configurations in SYS-05 are the source for a rebuild
manual_workaround: Hold non-urgent changes; rebuild SYS-02 by hand from the repository
dependent_third_parties: Platform vendor; repository vendor; IaaS provider
